Consequently, the following report elements are included:
Appendix A is an appropriations summary that includes a synopsis of the amount of appropriations made available by source
Appendix B presents details on the Disaster Relief Fund funding activities delineated by month.
Appendix C presents obligations and estimates by spending category for Hurricanes Sandy, Harvey, Irma, and Maria; Coronavirus Disease 2019; and declarations since August 1, 2017.
Appendix D presents funding summaries for the current active catastrophic events including the allocations, obligations, and expenditures.
Appendix F presents a bridge table that provides explanation for the monthly and baseline change for all activities to include details for catastrophic events.
Appendix G presents the fund history and current status of the Building Resilient Infrastructure and Communities/Predisaster Mitigation program.

notes: FEMA 'Disaster Relief Fund: Monthly Report as of September 30, 2025' (23 pages as served, letter, PScript5 / Acrobat Distiller 25 modified with iText 7.1.10, tagged; Last-Modified October 23, 2025; the FEMA listing dates it October 23, 2025, the cover October 22, 2025), cut to pages 1-15 with pypdf. Page 1: cover (photograph, title, date, 'Final Report to Congress for Fiscal Year 2025', DHS logo, agency name); page 2: 'Message from the Administrator' (photograph, four addressees, signature image); page 3: seal, title and 'Table of Contents'; pages 4-5: 'I. Legislative Language'; page 6: 'II. Background' with a numbered list; page 7: Appendix A; pages 8-9 (landscape): Appendix B details; pages 10-13 (landscape): Appendix B by catastrophic disaster; page 14: Appendix C; page 15 (landscape): Appendix D, four charts with data tables. Page 16 repeats the Appendix D running head and date and then starts new chart and table titles, as each Appendix D page does, so 15 is the largest k of at most 15 at whose end a table ends (judgement disclosed in holdout6/SELECTION.md; page 14 ends Appendix C). Headings: the cover title (vector text, checked at 400 dpi), 'Message from the Administrator', 'Table of Contents', 'I. Legislative Language' and 'II. Background' (large type, own line). The page-3 title (two lines in large type) and the small bold appendix running heads are not listed: the running heads repeat on every page of an appendix, like the table-page title blocks of the earlier sets, and the table titles are checked as phrases. Tables: eight are transcribed, see their names. Conventions (apply to every tool alike): a footnote marker printed as a superscript after a row or column label is written after one space ('Obligations (5)', 'Fiscal Year 2024 (1)'); a dollar sign printed at the left edge of an amount cell (accounting format) is written before the amount with one space ('$ 2,033', '$ (245)'), so the table rule keeps the comma there; multi-line header cells are joined with single spaces; the zero dashes of Appendix C and the hyphens of 'Full-Year' and the month headers ('October-24') are written as ASCII hyphen-minus (assumed); a merged or blank position is an empty string (not scored). Arithmetic checked while typing (a throwaway script): Appendix A: every subtotal and balance in all three columns and every Total = Major Declarations + Base, exactly; Appendix B block: Major Declarations + Base = Total Available in all 13 columns, and Total Available = beginning balance plus the rows between them in 10 of 12 months (October-24 sums to 22,586 and January-25 to 30,317 against 22,576 and 30,327 printed; both re-read at 400 dpi and kept as printed; the Total column, 9,576 / 8,413 / 1,163, equals the Appendix A balance); Appendix C: every row (cumulative + fiscal-year total = total through FY 2025, quarters sum to the fiscal-year total) and every column total, exactly; Appendix D: each Total column, exactly, and the obligations of Sandy, Harvey, Irma, Maria and COVID-19 equal Appendix C's totals through fiscal year 2025. must_contain: 52 items, each printed once in the kept pages and none crossing a page break: the cover line, addressee and signature lines, three contents entries whose appendices are not kept or are titled differently in the body, the statute text of pages 4-5 as phrases between labels, the background paragraphs and list items, the Appendix A title and notes, four row labels of Appendix B and the Appendix C title and note. Phrases avoid every hyphen ('Full-Year', 'Public Law 119-4', 'end-of-fiscal-year', 'prior-year', 'non-catastrophic'), the curly, straight and backtick quotation marks, the en dash in 'Agency-Disaster Relief Fund' and the apostrophe of 'Agency's'. The notes 'Actual transfer to Operations and Support for the Deployment Tracking System.', 'See Appendix G for additional information regarding the BRIC program balance.' and the 2021 act are printed on both pages 7 and 9 and are not used. ordered: 8 anchors on pages 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9 and 14. Noise: none; page numbers are too short and the repeated appendix running heads and table titles are part of the table pages. Chart titles, axis labels and legend text of page 15 are not checked (chart art). Absent: no line-end hyphenation, so absent is empty. BLIND PROTOCOL: chosen and answered before any converter or text extractor was run on the file; every check was typed from the rendered pages (pdftoppm at 40-400 dpi, read as images), and the PDF text layer was never read. Consequences: (1) text that may be an image (logos, seals, signatures, photographs, chart art) is not checked; (2) invisible text-layer content cannot be known, so noise lists only VISIBLE repeated page furniture; (3) where the exact code point of a glyph cannot be seen (curly vs straight quotes, dash and minus variants, line-end hyphens), must_contain phrases and ordered anchors avoid it; headings, table cells and absent entries that cannot avoid it are noted per file.
